implementation.publication: Reuses existing opt-in and internal reader publication slot. DICTIONARYWDFLT preserves typed/raw callbacks and fixed C/D raw suppression. ACDBPLACEHOLDER publishes only its existing raw callback with a null model in the separate new view; no typed placeholder callback or model is synthesized. Immutable raw storage and actual pointer identity expire at return/throw.
implementation.inputBinding: Before copying, verify actual reader-owned model/raw pointers, typed/raw phases and pre-copy common state; retain immutable snapshots, exact shared control blocks, container/generation/nonce and frozen text context. Copied, substituted, cross-import, dropped and duplicated inputs cannot become original producer evidence.
implementation.independentInventory: Distinct self, owner, reactor, extension-dictionary, dictionary entry350/360 and required default340 roles. Canonical dictionary flags/subclasses/names/defaults compare with the actual typed snapshot. Unknown payloads, omitted selected flag profiles, invalid/ambiguous names and wrong field order remain unavailable. Placeholder has a raw shell inventory, not typed replay proof.
implementation.rootJoin: Bind unique original NOD root, independently walked/decoded ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME key and exact owner350/360 slot to the original default dictionary. Check selected placeholder owners and persistent owner-dictionary reactor roles. Named aliases may share an object. A dictionary-wide fallback need not have a named entry: retain default and named-target roles separately. A known original placeholder with no named/default role stays unavailable as a plot-style target.
implementation.providers: Register qualified source records in the existing original TableReferenceAudit provider index, including NoTables imports, and in bounded common dependency nodes. Require the rooted role for LayerPlotStyle/PlotStyle matches; DictionaryDefault is a distinct non-null hard-pointer role, not an owning edge.
implementation.quotas: Independent record/group/byte/work limits, precharged snapshots/codec/reference workspace, physical census, root inventory and graph scans. Logical accounting is not measured RSS.
implementation.query: Read-only source/dependency inspection checks immutable audit/input/provider owners and context without allocation. Original facts remain independent of consumer edits; live/emitted verification remains separate.
